Red-box content is well covered. But the page's separate 'Ensure the patient ... is seen promptly' box (BP >= 180/110, systolic < 80, pulse irregular/>=100/<50, RR >= 30, temp >= 38, glucose < 3 (<4 diabetic) or >= 11.1, SpO2 < 92% at rest, exertional SpO2 < 87%, pregnant BP >= 140/90) is not encoded by any rule. Fracture/dislocation lack 'suspected'.

summary: The red-box urgent signs are encoded faithfully, but the 'seen promptly by nurse or doctor' vital-sign and glucose thresholds box (BP, pulse, temperature, glucose, oxygen saturation) is not encoded at all. The check_for task wrongly includes Cough, Unable to sit up and Known diabetic as urgent signs. The pregnancy, hypertension and diabetes check tasks drop weight, BP, urine dipstick, visual acuity, conditions and frequencies.
